fixes.red_output: java.lang.AssertionError: {"error":{"code":"SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE","message":"Service Unavailable",...}} expected:<413> but was:<503> (GET /auth/ops/overrun throwing new BodyTooLargeException(10))
fixes.rationale_strip: routerError answers an unwrapped BodyTooLargeException 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE before the isStoreFailure branch.
fixes.rationale_full: BodyTooLargeException extends IOException, so Auth.routerError fell through to isStoreFailure and answered 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with an ERROR 'a store failed' log for an auth.routes() handler that threw it. FR-APP-027 AC-1 requires an unwrapped overrun reaching the error flow to be 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; a new instanceof BodyTooLargeException branch, placed after HttpException and before isStoreFailure, answers respond(req,res,413,coreCode(413),null,null), the same response HttpException(413) gets on that path (same code and message, no new ERROR line). The check is instanceof on the thrown object only, so a wrapped overrun (RuntimeException(new BodyTooLargeException(10))) still takes the non-IOException path, logged 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (AC-3). A plain IOException is still the logged 503 store failure. isStoreFailure and public signatures are unchanged; no import of com.snoworca.naruserve.internal.
